text:
tara (eng-platform): Quick sync: proposing a compact "Cost Provenance" export and small inline row on the Cost dashboard. Goals: quick answer for "why did my cost change?", and a machine-readable daily CSV for billing reconciliation. Thoughts?

anaya (product): Customers want both the micrometric view and something they can hand to finance. The inline row should answer the question in one glance, then a button for 'Download provenance'. :+1:

drew (eng-telemetry): Telemetry constraints: we sample requests at variable rates. We can produce daily aggregates with fields (strings): token_burn, tokens_saved_est, shared_prefetch_pct, model_sku, routing_reason, sample_rate, derived_flag. derived_flag=true when we upsample from samples.

simeon (eng-runtime): Routing nuance: when quota triggers fallback to a cheaper variant, the effective cost drops but it's important to label the reason. routing_reason enum: [normal, quota_reroute, region_fallback, canary_split, manual_override]. UI should show the enum as an icon with hover text.

mika (billing): For CSV parity with invoices: include date, tenant_id, route_id, primary_tag, model_sku, token_burn, tokens_saved_est, dollars_saved_est, shared_prefetch_pct, routing_reason, sample_rate, derived_flag, correction_factor. We need dollars_saved_est for direct reconciliation, but it can be omitted from the inline UI by default.

lucy (design): Inline one-liner: "Tokens • Cache est. (pct) • SKU • reason". Keep money hidden unless the user toggles 'Show billing amounts'. Use "estimated" microcopy where derived_flag=true and a small amber dot for low confidence (sample_rate < 5%).

tara (eng-platform): API plan: add /v2/costs/provenance?range=1d&group=route which returns daily rows (small blob) and a CSV endpoint /v2/costs/provenance/download?group=route&date=YYYY-MM-DD. CSV generation should be rate-limited and require billing role for full exports.

drew (eng-telemetry): Precompute details: nightly job will read request_samples and prefetch_lineage and emit per-tenant per-route per-sku aggregates. Sample SQL prototype (very rough):

```
-- rough prototype: tokens saved estimation
select
  tenant_id,
  route_id,
  sku,
  date_trunc('day', ts) as day,
  sum(token_count) as token_burn_sampled,
  sum(case when cache_hit then token_count else 0 end) as tokens_saved_sampled,
  avg(sample_rate) as sample_rate
from request_samples
where ts >= now() - interval '1 day'
group by tenant_id, route_id, sku, day;
```

Then compute tokens_saved_est = tokens_saved_sampled * (1.0 / sample_rate) and join prefetch_lineage to compute shared_prefetch_pct. We'll also compute dollars_saved_est by joining nightly pricing table and storing as a materialized value.

simeon (eng-runtime): Canary delta: if rollout splits traffic, compute canary_percent and canary_cost_delta = cost(canary_variants) - cost(baseline). Expose those two small columns in the CSV and the modal drilldown.

mika (billing): Please include a correction_factor when derived_flag=true that we store so auditors can see how we upsampled. Also log the sample window and the raw sampled counts for transparency.

lucy (design): For the modal drilldown show: 1) a tiny sparkline, 2) three-row breakdown: tokens burned, cache saved (est), routing delta (with reason), 3) link to download CSV and 'Open full ledger' which takes finance to the export endpoint. Use clear microcopy: "Cache saved (estimated from 1% sample)" when sample_rate < 100%.

tara (eng-platform): Perf note: don't call the heavy provenance endpoint on hover. Bundle a compact provenance_blob with the dashboard payload (small JSON per visible route) and prefetch it when the user opens the dashboard. Keep the blob to one line per route and max 2KB per route.

drew (eng-telemetry): We'll add a derived_from_sample boolean and confidence_interval string like "±5%" for the UI. Confidence calculation will be conservative for low counts.

simeon (eng-runtime): Edgecase: shared-prefetch across tenants. When >10% of tokens_saved_est are shared across tenants, mark shared_prefetch_pct and show explanation: "Shared prefetch — savings allocated by hit-contribution". Add a note in CSV column allocation_method={proportional_by_hits, owner_by_prefetch} so finance can choose.

mika (billing): For the CSV, include both allocation_method and the raw lineage_id for traceability. Also require admin permission to download full-tenant exports; regular users can download route-scoped exports only.

ci-bot: CI queued -> provenance-api v0.2 -> staging. initiated by @tara.

anaya (product): Rollout plan? Beta with finance and three internal tenants first.

tara (eng-platform): Timeline: API PR this sprint, nightly precompute in staging next, UI toggle + modal after. Beta with billing + 3 tenants next week. If numbers look good we can canary to 10% tenants.

lucy (design): I'll produce compact and expanded mocks and attach to RFC. small ask: include the routing_reason icon set in the mock so engineers can map enums to icons.

drew (eng-telemetry): I'll paste a refined SQL and sample outputs in the RFC tomorrow. For now adding sample tenants for validation: tenant-cedar, tenant-lynx.

tara (eng-platform): Great. I'll open the RFC and include this thread. Please add any edgecases or test tenants in the RFC comments. Thanks all! :rocket:
